cardiac_arrest.title: Pediatric Cardiac Arrest
cardiac_arrest.subtitle: AHA/AAP 2025 PALS Figure 2

yes.label: VF / pulseless VT
actions: Shock (1st, 2 J/kg)
CPR 2 min + IV/IO access
Rhythm shockable? YES → Shock (2nd, 4 J/kg)
CPR 2 min + Epinephrine q3-5 min + consider advanced airway + capnography
Rhythm shockable? YES → Shock (≥4 J/kg, max 10 J/kg or adult)
CPR 2 min + Amiodarone OR Lidocaine + treat reversible causes
ROSC? → Post-Cardiac Arrest Care; no ROSC → repeat shock-CPR-drug cycle

no.label: Asystole / PEA
actions: Epinephrine ASAP
CPR 2 min + IV/IO access + Epi q3-5 min + consider advanced airway + capnography
Rhythm shockable? YES → switch to shockable pathway (Shock ASAP)
Rhythm still not shockable → CPR 2 min + treat reversible causes
Recheck rhythm shockable? YES → Shock ASAP; NO → continue nonshockable cycle
ROSC? → Post-Cardiac Arrest Care; no ROSC → repeat

energy_doses.label: Defibrillation 3rd+
energy_doses.note: ≥4 J/kg, max 10 J/kg or adult dose

high_quality_cpr: C:V ratio: 15:2 (2 rescuers, prepuberty); 30:2 (2 rescuers, postpuberty or 1 rescuer any age)
Advanced airway → continuous compressions + 1 breath q2-3 sec
Monitor ETCO2, invasive diastolic BP (if available)

tachy_pulse.title: Pediatric Tachyarrhythmia With Pulse
tachy_pulse.subtitle: AHA/AAP 2025 PALS Figure 7

branches.label: Probable SVT
branches.action: IV/IO Adenosine (if access established) OR Synchronized cardioversion

branches.label: Possible VT
branches.action: Synchronized cardioversion; consult expert before further medications

branches.label: Possible VT or SVT with aberrancy
branches.action: Expert consultation recommended; if regular + monomorphic, may consider Adenosine

energy_doses.label: Synchronized cardioversion 2nd
energy_doses.note: If 0.5-1 J/kg ineffective, increase to 2 J/kg; sedate if needed, do not delay cardioversion

tachy_pulse.refractory_note: Refractory SVT (cardiopulmonary compromise + vagal / adenosine / synchronized cardioversion all ineffective) and **expert consultation unavailable**, may consider IV procainamide, amiodarone, or sotalol

brady_pulse.title: Pediatric Bradycardia With Pulse
brady_pulse.subtitle: AHA/AAP 2025 PALS Figure 6
steps_initial: Assess cardiopulmonary compromise (altered MS / shock / hypotension)

yes.label: YES
actions: Maintain airway + O2; PPV PRN
Cardiopulmonary monitor; continuously monitor pulse
Bradycardia persists with ongoing compromise?
↳ NO → Identify and treat underlying causes; support ABCs; consider O2 / 12-lead; observe
↳ YES: HR <60 → Start CPR; IV/IO + Epinephrine; Atropine (use only for increased vagal tone or primary AV block)
Identify and treat underlying causes; consider transthoracic / transvenous pacing
Check pulse every 2 min
↳ Pulse present → return to "Bradycardia persists with ongoing compromise?"
↳ No pulse → go to Cardiac Arrest Algorithm

no.label: NO
actions: Identify and treat underlying causes
Support ABCs; consider O2, 12-lead ECG
Observe
